node.title: Re^2: Forcing list context. Brackets (with list within) as an unary right-associative operator
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: Hm... it seems like this might be [https://rt.perl.org/Public/Bug/Display.html?id=126193|#126193], fixed by [https://perl5.git.perl.org/perl.git/commitdiff/9e59c36b452568c56b99957f02b853c42e280f8a|9e59c36b] (at least that's what a bisect says), fix released with Perl v5.24.
